description: This Java class, EntityGroupUtil, provides utility methods for retrieving entity names and models associated with a specified entity group, using the OFBiz framework. It interacts with entity metadata and query mechanisms to filter and gather entity information based on groupings and configuration.

classes.name: EntityGroupUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for managing and retrieving entity group information within OFBiz.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a set of entity names that belong to the specified entity group, optionally requiring stamp fields.

methods.name: getModelEntitiesFromRecords
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of ModelEntity objects based on entity group entries, including logic for include/exclude rules and stamp field requirements.
